newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker at 43.7495/7500 to the dollar in interbank trading on Monday against the previous close at 43.7485/7495, dealers said.
The local currency was quoted in a wide spread between 43.7480/7600 per dollar in early trading, with most dollar selling banks not responding to demand.
"It's not the rate many banks are now concerned about. They are just searching for dollars as the central bank has tightened its own selling perhaps to discourage imports," said one dealer.
The call money rates closed at seven to nine percent against the previous 7.5-9.5 percent, dealers said.
